item.description: ### Fixed - **Droid approvals reach your iPhone again.** With some models (GPT-6.1 Sol among them), Droid 0.249 runs its tools from a script, and Perch couldn't tell which command it was asking about, so every approval had to be answered in the terminal. Perch now reads the command from Droid's script, and Allow still only goes once the dialog on screen shows that same command. A script it can't read is still left for the terminal. - **No Reply at Claude's multiple-choice questions.** A reply sent there was dropped, and Claude took whichever option was highlighted, so "Purple" could answer "Red". Perch no longer offers Reply on your iPhone or in the Mac notification for these questions. Answer them in Perch's question sheet, or in the terminal. Replying when a usage limit has reset ("press Enter to continue") still works.
